description_en: Performs a migration scale-out check on a specified ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 对指定云数据库ClickHouse集群进行迁移扩容检测
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse check-scale-out-balanced --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id cc-bp108z124a8o70000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --scaling-type ScaleOut --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckScaleOutBalanced

parameters.description_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~170875~~) operation to query the region ID.

The specification change type. Valid values:
- ScaleOut: horizontal scale-out
- ScaleIn: horizontal scale-in
- MultiAzUpgrade: upgrade to multi-active zone deployment
- DiskDownGrade: cloud disk downgrade.
